exceptions.policy_delta: Pearl may temporarily admit or recover providers while `proof_of_weights.require_autotune_hello_gate` is disabled or relaxed from the strict production expectation that verified in-window hardware/autotune evidence gates admission.
exceptions.authority_surface: Pearl coordinator overlay key `proof_of_weights.require_autotune_hello_gate`; coordinator config struct `ProofOfWeightsConfig.RequireAutotuneHelloGate`.
exceptions.reason: #582 records the 2026-07-13 onboarding deadlock where verified hardware evidence, trust inventory, catalog, and benchmark gates prevented the Air from joining until the hello gate was temporarily disabled.
exceptions.expiry_unknown_reason: Issue #615 lists the exception as current, but this docs lane did not read live Pearl config; the operator must verify the current overlay value and any deadline on Pearl.
exceptions.scope: Pearl production provider onboarding; known incident scope includes provider `augustass-macbook-air`, but live scope must be verified.
exceptions.removal_condition: Pearl admits fresh/restored providers through durable hardware-trust approval and strict hello-gate evidence without global gate disabling.
exceptions.rollback_command: ssh pearl 'sudo grep -A20 "^proof_of_weights:" /etc/macprovider/coordinator.yaml'; then restore the reviewed overlay value with `require_autotune_hello_gate: true` through the existing coordinator deploy/restart procedure.
exceptions.post_removal_validation: Confirm `/poolz` and coordinator logs show the provider admitted with verified in-window autotune evidence and no `autotune_evidence_required` bypass or relaxed hello-gate setting.

exceptions.policy_delta: Legacy CLI providers may be admitted through `provider_auth_policy.signature_exempt_until` instead of strict challenge-bound durable admission signatures.

exceptions.reason: #582/#585 recovery depended on a time-bounded CLI auth-policy exemption while durable CLI-owned admission identity migration and physical reboot/reconnect evidence remained incomplete.
exceptions.expiry_unknown_reason: #585 recorded an earlier 2026-07-16 expiry, while #615 lists the exemption as a current inventory item. Live `provider_auth_policy` rows must be checked before treating this row as complete.
exceptions.scope: Legacy CLI provider IDs on Pearl; known incident references include `mac` and `augustass-macbook-air`, but live DB rows are authoritative.
exceptions.removal_condition: All production providers reconnect after restart/reboot using durable admission signatures, and `provider_auth_policy` contains no unexpired signature exemption rows.
exceptions.rollback_command: ssh pearl 'sudo -u postgres psql <DB_NAME> -c "select provider_id, kind, signature_exempt_until, granted_by from provider_auth_policy where signature_exempt_until is not null order by signature_exempt_until;"' # placeholder DB name only; do not print secrets.
exceptions.post_removal_validation: Coordinator logs show `identityAdmissionSignature`/signature admission, no `provider_auth_policy_exempt_used` events, and both physical Macs buyer-serve without manual DB or Keychain edits.

exceptions.policy_delta: Recovery may mint or restore provider access without the ordinary restart-safe token path after Malibu/Keychain/import left a launchd provider bearerless.
exceptions.authority_surface: Coordinator bootstrap/recovery token paths and operator recovery commands; no bearer or secret values are stored in this register.
exceptions.reason: #582 records that tokenless recovery was needed to mint a fresh provider token after the running process had stale in-memory token state and the restarted launchd provider had no usable token.
exceptions.expiry_unknown_reason: The issue inventory identifies the exception, but live recovery authorizations or tokenless state were not inspected in this docs lane.
exceptions.scope: Pearl legacy provider recovery for affected provider IDs; exact live rows/authorizations require read-only Pearl verification.
exceptions.removal_condition: Provider credential custody is restart-safe and no tokenless/manual recovery path is needed for fresh install, import, restart, logout/login, or reboot.
exceptions.rollback_command: Use only the reviewed recovery command's dry-run/status mode for the specific provider ID; revoke or let expire recovery authorization through the coordinator's documented operator path before enforcing ordinary token custody.
exceptions.post_removal_validation: A restarted launchd provider authenticates without GUI prompts or tokenless recovery; coordinator audit logs show no recovery-token fallback for the validation window.

exceptions.policy_delta: Tier-2 model-hash mismatch enforcement remains contained or bridged for legacy/missing `model_hash_algorithm` providers instead of strictly rejecting every untyped or mismatched model hash.
exceptions.reason: #609 records that v1.8.40 compared unlike hash algorithms and production temporarily deactivated the Tier-2 catalog consumer while retaining signed catalog files. Entry 170 permits only a finite legacy algorithm bridge.
exceptions.expiry_unknown_reason: The bridge deadline is intentionally supplied from Pearl env and was not read in this docs lane; operators must record the live `MODEL_HASH_LEGACY_UNTIL` value.
exceptions.scope: Affected pre-canonical providers that omit `model_hash_algorithm`; no arbitrary stale catalog or explicit unknown algorithm is permitted.
exceptions.removal_condition: Observed legacy provider count reaches zero, a physical provider reports canonical `macprovider.snapshot-manifest.v1` identity and buyer-serves, and the Tier-2 bridge field is removed so missing algorithms fail closed.
exceptions.rollback_command: ssh pearl 'sudo grep -E "MODEL_HASH_LEGACY_UNTIL|model_hash_legacy_until|require_hash_verified" /etc/macprovider/coordinator.env /etc/macprovider/coordinator.yaml' # read-only; then remove the bridge via reviewed coordinator config PR/deploy.
exceptions.post_removal_validation: Coordinator rejects missing/unknown `model_hash_algorithm`, emits no `model_hash_algorithm_legacy_bridge`, and #613 physical evidence shows buyer-serving with canonical artifact identity.

exceptions.policy_delta: Production rollout cannot rely on the canary as a stable gate: `canary-buyer.timer` remains disabled while an unexpected reviewed-enable gate file may exist and must be reconciled.
exceptions.authority_surface: systemd units `canary-buyer.timer` and `canary-buyer.service`; non-secret enable gate `/etc/macprovider-canary-buyer/enabled`; emergency sentinel `/var/lib/macprovider-canary-buyer/DISABLED`.
exceptions.reason: #584 records the canary-induced provider degradation incident and a 2026-07-16 checkpoint that the timer is disabled/inactive while an unexpected enable-gate file exists.
exceptions.expiry_unknown_reason: The canary remains blocked until #584 physical baselines, safe qualification, emergency-disable drill, and approved re-enable evidence pass; this docs lane did not inspect live systemd or gate-file state.
exceptions.scope: Pearl production canary/liveness and rollout-gate use.
exceptions.removal_condition: #584 re-enable gate passes with reviewed physical evidence; the unexpected gate file is either removed while disabled or recreated only after approval.
exceptions.rollback_command: ssh pearl 'sudo systemctl disable --now canary-buyer.timer; sudo systemctl stop canary-buyer.service; sudo rm -f /etc/macprovider-canary-buyer/enabled; sudo install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /var/lib/macprovider-canary-buyer; sudo touch /var/lib/macprovider-canary-buyer/DISABLED'
exceptions.post_removal_validation: `systemctl is-enabled/is-active` show the approved state, gate-file presence matches the approval record, and canary evidence includes post-probe pool safety with the expected production fleet.

exceptions.scope: Pearl catalog/admission consumers across coordinator, provider CLI, and Tier-2 during migration.
exceptions.removal_condition: Autotune and Tier-2 consume the same signed model identity rows, rollback restores one complete release, and production emits no model-hash uncatalogued events for active signed release rows.
exceptions.rollback_command: Use the catalog-release/provider-upgrade runbook to restore one complete signed catalog release set; do not edit Tier-2 identity separately from the network release.
exceptions.post_removal_validation: Coordinator active release identity and component digests match the signed release; Tier-2 expected identity is generated from the same row; no duplicate legacy catalog file participates in modern decisions.
